nodes.label: Vesta Label Taxonomy (Type + Priority + Area)
nodes.rationale: Every triaged issue gets exactly one type label, exactly one priority label, and one or more area labels so labeling stays consistent across sessions; bug and enhancement never co-occur because missing is not broken.

nodes.label: Duplicate Detection & Merging Policy
nodes.rationale: Auto-merge only unambiguous clusters (>=2 shared signals plus matching area) because closing issues is visible to others and reverses poorly; borderline pairs are surfaced for the user to confirm. Unique content is quoted verbatim into the canonical so the author's wording is preserved.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits Title Format
nodes.rationale: type(scope): description, lowercase, imperative, no trailing period; for issues the type reflects the intended outcome (reported breakage -> fix, feature ask -> feat), and open investigations drop the type entirely.
